sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 60% of max HP.
HP recovery boosted by 10% for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 50 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies despair for 60 seconds with a success value of 70.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 30 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical and magic damage taken by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Auto Refresh (continuous buff that renews the effect "removes status ailments" every 10 seconds) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 60 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 10000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 10000
